lede: Wrap each heading & everything under it in a section that carries the heading's ID. Intersection observers get a real element to watch, so a table of contents can show where the reader is.

usage.caption: Each heading opens a section, nested by level & closed when the next heading of the same or a higher level arrives.

features.title: A real element to observe
features.description: Each heading & everything under it sits in a section, nested by heading level, so an IntersectionObserver has something to watch.

features.title: IDs that make good link targets
features.description: Section IDs come from the full heading text & are percent-encoded, so every one works in a URL, even for non-Latin headings. Duplicate headings are numbered.

features.title: Active styles in plain CSS
features.description: With the ID on the section, the :target-current selector can highlight the link for the section in view. A small observer covers browsers without it.

features.title: Named regions for assistive technology
features.description: Every section is labelled by its heading, so a screen reader exposes it as a named region.

features.title: Works with markdown-it-attrs
features.description: Classes & an explicit ID set on a heading carry over to its section.

features.title: No configuration
features.description: Add it with use() & it works. Pass a slugify function when you want different IDs.
